sonarr.name: Sonarr
sonarr.notice: SlipStream's release parser (`internal/release`) and the series Content Type's title and numbering rules (`internal/contenttypes/series`) are Go ports of Sonarr's C# parser, copyright the Sonarr contributors and modified for SlipStream. Their regular expressions are Sonarr's, copied as data into each package's `internal/upstream`, and each package's `upstream.json` maps its Go files to the Sonarr files they port. The parser's golden tests read Sonarr's parser test cases at the commit above, and the formats package ports Sonarr's Custom Format conditions and enums. The naming tests read Sonarr's file naming test cases at the same commit.

radarr.name: Radarr
radarr.notice: SlipStream's release parser (`internal/release`) and the movie Content Type's title rules (`internal/contenttypes/movie`) are Go ports of Radarr's C# parser, copyright the Radarr contributors and modified for SlipStream. Their regular expressions are Radarr's, copied as data into each package's `internal/upstream`, and each package's `upstream.json` maps its Go files to the Radarr files they port. The parser's golden tests read Radarr's parser test cases at the commit above, and the formats package ports Radarr's Custom Format conditions and enums. The naming tests read Radarr's file naming test cases at the same commit.

trash.name: TRaSH Guides
trash.notice: The release parser reads HDR, video codec, audio codec and channels from a release name with the conditions of TRaSH Guides' Custom Formats, copied as data into `internal/release/internal/upstream`. The formats tests run every TRaSH Custom Format from a snapshot in `internal/formats/testdata/trash`. The naming tests parse every TRaSH naming template from a snapshot in `internal/naming/testdata/trash`.

skip.should_not_replace_custom_formats_due_to: Sonarr prints a token with an empty modifier as typed. SlipStream refuses the template.

skip.should_escape_token_in_format: Sonarr's {{ and }} escape, which SlipStream refuses because it means the opposite of Radarr's {{Edition Tags}}.
skip.should_format_languagecodes_properly: Reads ISO 639-2 codes through {MediaInfo Full}, which Sonarr builds from a codec model.
skip.should_replace_all_tokens_for_different_: Sets the C# thread culture, which SlipStream has no counterpart for.
skip.should_include_hdr_for_mediainfo_videody: Sets an HdrFormat on a media info model. SlipStream reads dynamic range from its own facts.
skip.should_use_updated_media_info_if_token_c: Tests when Sonarr probes a file again, which naming has no part in.
